variants.probe_result: First case0 launch timed out with code4; no output mismatch was observed before launch failure.

adoption.reason: Both full FFN variants regressed against their contemporary E128 brackets. v2 also has incomplete standalone validation, not a demonstrated whole-kernel arithmetic error.

further_tuning.reason: No more row/lookup-count sweep, no timeout repair series for these measured regressions. Row4+tail corrected an initial cost oversight; it was not a new architecture.

major_research.question: Reassess E93/E95 positive but incompletely validated native-down combinations and the untried E5M2 post-GeGLU quantization/native-down path with its complete quantization, broadcast, scale and F32 reduction costs. QKV/O remain equally weighted score targets.
major_research.no_claim: No new native-down implementation, validation, speedup or top10 guarantee.

scope: E129 projection-cluster design is separately blocked at target lowering. E131 retains explicit joint assembly.
Each variant has one whole-kernel allocation; these are not repeats of one binary.

Up/gate FP8 logical weight write/read112.5MiB each is removed but56.25MiB packed and7.03125MiB scale joint writes/reads are added; net49.21875MiB each is not an observed bus-traffic or latency measurement.
Actual hardware stall attribution is absent. v2 diagnostic and whole images have different schedules and allocations despite a byte-identical production source prefix.
No extra6 input expansion, adoption repeats or official submission followed the negative screens.
